title: SF439 (2025-2026 Regular): Permissible methods of submitting an application for a permit to carry a handgun expansion

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-01-16; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/SF/439/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version (Introduction, 2025-01-16). Strikes the word 'must', so in-person submission is no longer the only method.

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 3(e)): Applications may be submitted in person, electronically, or by facsimile, certified mail, or certified delivery.
